resource_bound_amendment.reason: The initially frozen virtual-address-space limit prevented Lean from creating a thread (libc++abi: failed to create thread: Resource temporarily unavailable). This changes only the compilation and checker resource ceiling, not the seven selected fixtures, roots, expected verdicts, permitted axioms, Lean version or export format. No fixture exported and no checker verdict was observed under the original ceiling.

cases.rationale: The lambda applies f to its bound variable; eta converts it to f for arbitrary f and unused g.
Replace f with the distinct, same-typed g inside the lambda; eta now yields g, not the claimed f. The proof and every other export record stay unchanged.
For p : Nat × Nat, the constructor of its first and second projections is definitionally p.
Replace the second projection by the same-typed first projection. The reconstructed pair need not be p; the original reflexivity proof no longer has the claimed type.
The ordinary decide proof of 2 + 2 = 4 contains no forbidden axiom.
The same proposition proved with native_decide exports a per-invocation native axiom; Lean may replay the axiom, but the existing strict generic allowlist must refuse it.
The public theorem uses a private helper that invokes native_decide; the transitive proof closure must expose its forbidden generated axiom.
